# En av många kinesiska oroshärdar

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-10-13  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon's 13 October 2026 episode covered a sharp tech sell-off in South Korea. The KOSPI fell about 6.3% after the Chinese chipmaker CXMT moved into higher-margin memory, and Broadcom's CEO compared AI investing to a casino. LVMH's report showed weak Chinese consumer demand: Asia fell 5% and China dropped by double digits. The hosts noted a growing split between luxury names, with LVMH and Kering down while Brunello Cucinelli kept rising. Other topics were the IMF's warning on debt, Brent oil around $105, US 10-year yields at 5.20%, US bank earnings starting, buyout talk around Bumble and Nokia's divestment.
